title: gdpr.owner.probe
description: Daily liveness probe from stapel-gdpr. Answered with gdpr.owner.alive from the same subscriber that handles gdpr.erasure.requested — until 0.25.0 stapel-auth answered no probe at all, which is why owners-health reported `auth: alive=false` in deployments whose erasure worked. Documentation of what is consumed: the authoritative schema is the emitter's, in stapel-gdpr/schemas/emits/.
